reviews.text: I expressly requested cutlery as we got it delivered to a forest for a picnic. I also asked the driver if it included cutlery and he confirmed it was included. The receipt on the bag also confirmed cutlery had been added. There was no cutlery with our order and since I ordered a ramen soup, I was unable to eat it. We had to go home to eat it which defeated the whole purpose of having a picnic. We had to heat it up at home as it was cold. Unacceptable for £40. Please ensure that cutlery is always added if requested, as many people order deliveries because they are away from home.

The taste is good I can’t lie. But I had to write a review because it feels like they put more effort in the fancy takeaway bag than the portion of the food. No shade but, £15 for 1 short tender broccoli, small chicken breast cut in 5 slices and 5 sips of miso soup doesn’t feel worth the purchase. It had a nice portion of rice though and it was well packaged.

This place is honestly amazing! i ate at the restaurant and thought it was great so i decided to order some for home delivery. when i tell you the amount of thought and care that has gone into just solely making sure the food gets here nicely presented and hot, even for a far distance may i add, is impeccable. i don’t usually write reviews but wow the ramen here is incredible. the noodles aren’t the cheap cr*p and really lovely! i will forever be coming back thank you !
